## Objective

Become the bookkeeping app small businesses keep using, because closing the books takes them an hour a month

**By:** 2029-12-31

Growth has come from sign-ups; the business now depends on accounts staying and owners recommending us.

## Goals

| Goal | Owner | Baseline | Target | Current | Due | Status |
|------|-------|----------|--------|---------|-----|--------|
| Accounts still active at 90 days | Head of Product | 52% | 65% | 53% | 2029-12-31 | On Track |
| Paying accounts | Chief Revenue Officer | 40,000 accounts | 100,000 accounts |  | 2029-12-31 |  |
| Hours owners spend on their books each month<br>Median from the twice-yearly owner survey. | Head of Research | 6 hours | 2 hours |  | 2029-12-31 |  |

## Strategies

### 1. Get every new account to a reconciled month in its first week

**Owner:** Head of Onboarding · **Priority:** P0 · **Serves:** Accounts still active at 90 days; Hours owners spend on their books each month

Accounts that reconcile a month early stay. Connecting a bank is where they stall.

**Measures**

| Measure | Owner | Baseline | Target | Current | Frequency | Status |
|---------|-------|----------|--------|---------|-----------|--------|
| New accounts that connect a bank in their first session | Head of Onboarding | 45% | 75% | 51% | Weekly | On Track |

**Actions**

| Action | Owner | Timing | Status |
|--------|-------|--------|--------|
| Ship guided bank import | Onboarding squad | 2027-01-04 to 2027-03-26 | In Progress |
| Walk new accounts through their first reconciled month | Onboarding squad | 2027-04-05 to 2027-06-25 | Planned |
